# compute_split_keywords { #dyf.compute_split_keywords }

```python
compute_split_keywords(
    titles,
    tree,
    leaf_batches,
    children_map,
    *,
    max_depth_from_root=3,
    min_child_items=50,
    top_k=10,
    domain_stopwords=None,
    bigram_check=False,
)
```

Compute discriminative TF-IDF keywords for each side of each tree split.

For each internal node (up to max_depth_from_root), treats each child as a
"document class" and computes TF-IDF scores to find discriminative words.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                | Type                                                                     | Description                                   | Default    |
|---------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------|------------|
| titles              | [list](`list`)\[[str](`str`)\]                                           | List of title strings, indexed by item index. | _required_ |
| tree                | [list](`list`)\[[TreeNode](`dyf.lazy_index.TreeNode`)\]                  | Tree structure from idx.get_tree_structure(). | _required_ |
| leaf_batches        | [dict](`dict`)\[[int](`int`), [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`)\] | {node_id: item_indices} for leaf nodes.       | _required_ |
| children_map        | [dict](`dict`)\[[int](`int`), [list](`list`)\[[int](`int`)\]\]           | {parent_id: [child_ids]} for internal nodes.  | _required_ |
| max_depth_from_root | [int](`int`)                                                             | Maximum tree depth to process.                | `3`        |
| min_child_items     | [int](`int`)                                                             | Skip children with fewer items than this.     | `50`       |
| top_k               | [int](`int`)                                                             | Number of top keywords to return per child.   | `10`       |
| domain_stopwords    | [set](`set`)\[[str](`str`)\] \| None                                     | Additional stop words to filter.              | `None`     |
| bigram_check        | [bool](`bool`)                                                           | Enable PMI-based compound meaning detection.  | `False`    |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
|--------|----------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [dict](`dict`) | dict with keys: "domain_stopwords": list of domain stop words used "splits": {node_id: {     "depth": int,     "children": {child_id: {         "count": int,         "unigrams": [("word", score), ...],         "bigrams": [("w1_w2", score), ...],  # if bigram_check     }},     "bigram_needed": bool,  # if bigram_check }} |
